terminalContract: Every local run of the complete .NET coverage inventory, including every --all caller such as main-package.yml, runs UiSmoke as the declared partition: two explicit type lists plus the complement (k=3). Every real FullyQualifiedName listed by VSTest must satisfy grammar G, and the FQN sets must equal the display-derived method sets, unfiltered and per part, or the lane fails; the lane also fails when NFC_VISUAL_OUTPUT_DIR, NFC_UI_REFERENCE_CAPTURE_DIR or NFC_REPORT_VISUAL_INPUT is set. Each part runs from its own complete, link-free, hash-verified copy of the Release output, with real filtered discovery and one TRX and coverage pair. Before tests, exactly the declared parts are present and non-empty, each filtered discovery equals the declaration applied to the unfiltered discovery, the parts are pairwise disjoint and their Counter sum equals the unfiltered discovery; after tests, each part's TRX equals its own filtered discovery with no failure or unapproved skip, and every part assembly hash equals the source hash. Any failed check fails the lane closed; there is no substitute evidence path. Parts run together (at most 3), exclusive of other projects, 600 s each; a failing part does not stop the others, but the project fails and no coverage verdict passes; freshness runs after all collectors. CI shard commands, required-check selection, release-Golden execution, coverage policy, Infrastructure settings and exclusivity, inventories, deadlines and cancellation are unchanged; no retry, skip or timeout increase.

Round 2 closed the fallback and principal scheduling, test-plan, ADR and runtime-scope concerns, but remained BLOCKED on actual-FQN binding, integrationPaths classification and the compiled-type writer inventory. Round 3 reviewed DESIGN-local-verify-speed.v3.md against checkout f3801b4c7b67054900549fbd043438347735ab26; scripts/verify.py, scripts/coverage_policy.py and tests/scripts/test_verify_orchestration.py match c250ed8a5. Read-only inspection of installed VSTest 18.6.0 and the existing xUnit adapter confirmed that FQN listing and FullyQualifiedName filtering read TestCase.FullyQualifiedName, and TRX TestMethod is derived from that FQN. Supplied probes reconcile 1,720 display entries with 1,040 FQNs, 322 part-1 entries with 210 FQNs, and 1,040 xUnit method records; all 1,720 existing three-part TRX cases satisfy the per-case identity relation. Revision 3 closes R2-F1–F3 through real-FQN grammar validation, set reconciliation, mandatory per-case TRX binding, governed-only final ownership and corrected writer isolation. A non-blocking P3 corrects the SDK assumption: global.json permits latestPatch roll-forward and this checkout resolves SDK 10.0.303; compatibility relies on runtime fail-closed checks, not an exact SDK pin. The owner’s fixed-head main-package dispatch remains a pre-merge gate, stopping merge on timeout or clear regression.
